messages:
Maya R.: heads up: deploy-bot paused promotion for release v1.13.0 — CI verify failed: artifact checksum mismatch between origin and cache node. holding change window at 16:00 PT. https://ci.internal/r/9900 :warning:

deploy-bot: Promotion paused: release=v1.13.0; reason=artifact_checksum_mismatch; key=builds/2026/03/25/v1.13.0.tar.gz; attempts=2; last_error='expected=dd77ee88 got=bb66cc55'

Ben (infra): quick confirm: origin sha=dd77ee88, cache-node-3 sha=bb66cc55. content-length identical. likely cache corruption on node-3.

Ilya - Release Eng: options: 1) pin to last_good artifact (tag=release/v1.13.0-lastgood) and proceed, 2) wait for infra repair (unknown), 3) manual reupload. Release notes + customer comms are scheduled for 17:00 PT.

Priya QA: last_good passed smoke yesterday. I'm +pin + quick canary smoke after promote.

Ben (infra): I'll open ticket STOR-321 and kick reupload to node-3. If you approve pin, I'll run promote from lastgood and track reconciliation.

Ilya - Release Eng: approve pin. deploy-bot suggested_action=pin; suggested_tag=release/v1.13.0-lastgood; to_confirm=@Ilya run `deploy-bot confirm-pin release/v1.13.0-lastgood`

deploy-bot: pin confirmed by Ilya. starting promote job promote-5555. logs: https://ci.internal/jobs/promote-5555

ci-bot: promote-5555 -> SUCCESS. promoted_artifact=release/v1.13.0-lastgood.tar.gz

Priya QA: canary smoke started (6m). will report result.

Ben (infra): ticket STOR-321 created: https://tracker/internal/STOR-321 assigned infra-storage. reupload running to node-3.

Priya QA: canary smoke all green. signing off. :rocket:

Ilya - Release Eng: updated release notes draft with: "Artifact pinned to last good build due to cache-node checksum inconsistency; infra reconciling (STOR-321)." Scheduling final announcement at 17:00 PT. Closing thread; follow-ups tracked on STOR-321 and infra backlog.
